alt: Vertebral column - anterior view (left) and lateral view (right) with all five regions labeled: 7 cervical vertebrae (C1-C7) forming the cervical curve, 12 thoracic (T1-T12), 5 lumbar (L1-L5), fused sacrum, and coccyx. Intervertebral discs visible between bodies.
